items.title: Accept or decline the offered Krippenplatz
items.quote: Bitte sagen Sie uns binnen 12 Arbeitstagen ab dem Datum dieses Briefes zu oder ab.
items.computation: Sender is a private company (gGmbH), not an authority, so there is no statutory deemed-delivery rule; the letter itself fixes the start as the date of the letter, 19.11.2026 (Thursday). The letter specifies the count explicitly: 'Gezählt werden Montag bis Freitag; Feiertage bleiben außer Betracht' — i.e. 12 working days (Mon-Fri, public holidays skipped), with the start day itself not counted (consistent with the usual way such periods are counted, §187 BGB by analogy). Counting from 20.11.2026 (Fri, day 1) forward, skipping Sat/Sun, over the Hessian calendar (seat of the Kita in 35390 Mustergießen, no holidays fall in this window): day 1 = Fri 20.11, day 2 = Mon 23.11, day 3 = Tue 24.11, day 4 = Wed 25.11, day 5 = Thu 26.11, day 6 = Fri 27.11, day 7 = Mon 30.11, day 8 = Tue 01.12, day 9 = Wed 02.12, day 10 = Thu 03.12, day 11 = Fri 04.12, day 12 = Mon 07.12.2026. Confirmed by the working-day tool: 12 business days after 2026-11-19 (Hessen calendar, no holidays skipped besides weekends) = 2026-12-07 (Monday).

warnings: The letter offers a childcare place starting 01.02.2027 and only asks for a yes/no reply by the deadline; it contains no payment demand, so the IBAN printed in the footer (which fails the standard checksum check) is not something you need to act on now — but double‑check it with the Kita before ever transferring money to this account.

If no reply reaches the Kita by the deadline ('Ohne Rückmeldung vergeben wir den Platz an die nächste Familie auf der Warteliste'), the place will be given away, so confirm acceptance in writing (email/letter) well before 2026-12-07 and keep proof of sending.
